items.title: 俳句アドベンチャー「OKU」，松竹ゲームズが共同パブリッシャとして参画。Steamフォロワー30万超の注目作がTGS 2026に出展決定

zh.title: Shochiku Games 作为俳句冒险游戏“OKU”的联合发行商参与其中。拥有超过 30 万 Steam 粉丝的精选作品将在 TGS 2026 上展出
zh.summary: 松竹游戏今天宣布，结合“俳句日”，它将作为 Irox Games 开发的俳句冒险游戏“OKU”的联合发行商参与其中。这是一款在 Steam 上拥有超过 30 万粉丝的著名作品，让您在通过组合单词创作俳句的同时穿越美丽的世界。它还决定在2026年东京电玩展上展出。

en.title: Shochiku Games is participating as a co-publisher of the haiku adventure "OKU". Featured works with over 300,000 Steam followers will be exhibited at TGS 2026

It is a notable work that has over 300,000 followers on Steam, and allows you to travel through a beautiful world while composing haiku by combining words. It has also been decided to exhibit at Tokyo Game Show 2026.

en.title: In order to find "something" to save people on the ground, he transforms into an industrial robot with a human consciousness and enters an underground facility in the former Soviet Union. Horror ADV “IRONWAKE”, trial version now available
en.summary: EnunionTeam is currently distributing the trial version of the horror ADV "IRONWAKE" for PC. This work is set in 2050, after a nuclear war, and explores underground facilities in the former Soviet Union as an industrial robot with a human consciousness transferred to it. While piloting a heavy and slow aircraft and defeating enemies that cannot be defeated in battle, you search for the ``something'' needed to save the people on the ground.

en.title: Trial version of ``No More Ground'', a penance-based 3D action game that uses parkour to climb scaffolding in the air, is now available on Steam
en.summary: Amadare Works today began distributing the trial version of ``NoMoreGround'' on Steam. This is a 3D action game in which players use parkour to climb aerial scaffolding connecting buildings, houses, islands, etc., aiming to reach the top. en.title: Anime production market exceeds 400 billion yen for the first time, but may peak out - Are labor shortages and in-house IP the key? Teikoku Databank conducts industry survey
en.summary: Teikoku Databank conducted an industry survey targeting anime production companies based on the credit report file "CCR" containing 2 million companies and other external information. items.summary: 我们总说中华文明上下五千年，尽管专家、学者们对具体的年代数字还持有争议，考古学界的断代考古工程也一直在进行，但若说一句我们的文明历史是“源远流长”，这一点应该是一个绝对的共识。对于我们来说那些盘古开天、女娲造人的故事就是传说中的“上古时代”或者说“神话时代”，而到了 大禹治水、精卫填海 等故事的时代，则是一个人神的历史和传说相互交集的时代，渡过这个时代后，再往后拥有考古依据支持的中华历史就越发明晰。而这些历史时代中，哪怕仅仅是通过神话、传说、故事、寓言等民间口耳相传的巨大信息量就是任何学者、专家穷其一生恐怕也很难窥得全貌的量级。那么，如果有人想要把这些都整合到一款桌游之中，记录下来，传递出去。

ja.summary: 私たちはいつも中国文明は5000年続いたと言います。専門家や学者は依然として具体的な年数について議論しており、考古学界は年代順の考古学プロジェクトを実施しているが、私たちの文明には「長い歴史」があると言うのであれば、これは絶対的なコンセンサスとなるはずである。私たちにとって、盤古が天を創造し、女媧が人間を創造した物語は、伝説上の「古代」、あるいは「神話の時代」です。太夫の治水や景偉の海開拓などの物語の時代は、人と神の歴史と伝説が交錯する時代。この時代を経て、考古学的証拠に裏付けられた中国の歴史がより明らかになるだろう。これらの歴史的時代では、たとえそれが神話、伝説、物語、寓話、その他の民間の口承伝承を通してのみであったとしても、情報量は非常に膨大であり、どんな学者や専門家でも生涯にその全体像を把握することは困難です。したがって、誰かがこれらすべてをボードゲームに統合したい場合は、それを記録して渡してください。

For us, those stories about Pangu creating the sky and Nuwa creating humans are the legendary "ancient times" or "mythological times". The era of stories such as Dayu's flood control and Jingwei's reclamation of the sea is an era where the history and legends of humans and gods intersect with each other. After passing through this era, the Chinese history supported by archaeological evidence will become more clear. In these historical eras, even if it is only through myths, legends, stories, fables and other folk oral traditions, the huge amount of information is so large that it is difficult for any scholar or expert to get a full picture of it in his lifetime. So, if someone wants to integrate all of this into a board game, record it and pass it on.

ja.title: Vol.132 2026年のスパイダーマン作品には一体何が期待されるのか？
ja.summary: ゲスト: Lipsky 表紙/編集/ポストプロダクション: Ac 今年の「Brand New Day」は評判も興行収入も良好ですが、このプログラムの重要なトピックはそれだけではありません。 2026 年の時点で、スパイダーマンの映画とテレビの歴史は豊かで長いものであると言えます。 21 世紀以降だけでも、3 つの実写映画シリーズ、1 つのアニメ映画シリーズ、そして無数のアニメ シリーズ バージョンが制作されています。 20年以上にわたり、ファンとして私たちは数え切れないほどのスパイダーマンを体験し、スパイダーマンの喜びと悲しみ、生と死、愛と憎しみを見てきました。そして私たちの好み、期待、要求は自然にさらに厳しく、複雑で奥深いものになっています。現在、スパイダーマン映画を公開するとき、「誰が登場するか、何が登場するか、どのように撮影するか」よりも、おそらく「もっと見たいものは何か」という質問がより重要になっています。このエピソードでは、私たちの長年の友人であり、漫画愛好家でもあるリプスキーを招待します。

en.title: Vol.132 What exactly do we expect from a Spider-Man work in 2026?
en.summary: Guest: Lipsky Cover/Editor/Post-production: Ac Although this year's "Brand New Day" has received good reputation and box office, it is not the only key topic of this program. As of 2026, Spider-Man's film and television history can be described as rich and long. Since the 21st century alone, there have been three live-action movie series, one animated movie series and countless animated series versions. For more than 20 years, as fans, we have experienced countless versions of Spider-Man, and have seen Spider-Man's joys and sorrows, life and death, love and hatred; and our tastes, expectations and demands have naturally become more picky, complex and profound. Nowadays, when opening a Spider-Man movie, rather than "who is in it, what is in it, and how to film it," perhaps the more important question to ask is "what do we want to see more?" In this episode, we invite our long-time friend Lipsky, who is also a comic lover.

en.title: Have you discovered the standby mode of "Under the Sea of ​​Fog"?
en.summary: "Under the Sea of ​​Fog" adds a "standby mode" to the game. I discovered it accidentally while testing this game yesterday. At that time, I happened to stop to collect my thoughts and reply to a few work messages on the computer. Within a few minutes, the music in the game suddenly changed, relaxed jazz slowly started playing, and the screen cut to an empty sofa next to the fire. The whole process is very natural, just like entering a screensaver: the time is displayed on the screen, and you can return to the game by sliding the slider. This is a small detail, but it is a moment that left a deep impression on me during the first test of "Under the Sea of ​​Fog". The standby screen I accidentally discovered yesterday. Because for a game that is still in the first beta stage, some things can actually be "less complete". Temporarily replaced art resources, UI that has not had time to be polished, and systems that have not been perfected are all common. The purpose of the first beta test is to allow players to get in touch with the core of the game in advance.

ja.title: サウジアラビア、eスポーツワールドカップを2027年末まで延期すると発表

en.title: Saudi Arabia announces postponement of eSports World Cup to late 2027
en.summary: Due to the turmoil in the Middle East, the first ENC Esports World Cup originally scheduled to be held in Riyadh in November 2026 has been postponed to November 2027. In view of the transnational scale of the E-Sports World Cup and the uncertainty of the regional situation, the Foundation believes that postponement can provide a stable environment for national teams, publishers and fans. This event was announced by the Saudi E-Sports World Cup Foundation in August 2025. It is positioned as the world's first comprehensive e-Sports event held regularly with the national team as a unit. It is held every two years. Participants represent the country rather than the club. It is worth mentioning that the background of the E-sports World Cup is the breakdown of negotiations between the International Olympic Committee (IOC) and Saudi Arabia on the "E-sports Olympics" project. The two parties originally planned to jointly host the first Olympic E-sports Games, but the cooperation was terminated in October 2025, and Saudi Arabia immediately started a new one with ENC.

items.title: オレンジやレモンなどのかんきつ類に含まれる成分が「肝臓を若返らせる」かもしれない
items.summary: 肝臓は栄養素の処理や血液中の有害物質のろ過など、500種類以上もの重要な機能を担っている臓器です。そんな肝臓の老化を「オレンジやレモンなどのかんきつ類に含まれる成分」が逆転させ、若い頃の状態に戻せる可能性があるとの研究結果が発表されました。続きを読む...

zh.summary: 肝脏是一个执行 500 多种重要功能的器官，例如处理营养物质和过滤血液中的有害物质。研究结果已公布，“橙子和柠檬等柑橘类水果中含有的成分”可能能够逆转肝脏的老化，使其恢复年轻状态。阅读更多...

en.title: Ingredients found in citrus fruits such as oranges and lemons may 'rejuvenate the liver'
en.summary: The liver is an organ that performs over 500 important functions, such as processing nutrients and filtering harmful substances from the blood. Research results have been announced that ``components contained in citrus fruits such as oranges and lemons'' may be able to reverse such aging of the liver and return it to its youthful state. read more...

items.title: AIエージェントは「記憶」が多いほど賢くなるわけではない、IBM Researchが8モデルで検証
items.summary: AIエージェントに過去の経験を「記憶」として大量に与えても、必ずしも性能が高くなるわけではないことがIBM Researchの実験で示されました。AIモデルによっては、すべての記憶を渡すより必要な情報だけを選んだ方が高い性能を発揮するとのことです。続きを読む...

zh.title: IBM 研究中心对 8 个模型进行了测试，AI 代理并不会因为“内存”增多而变得更聪明
zh.summary: IBM Research 的一项实验表明，即使你给 AI 代理大量过去的经验作为“记忆”，它的性能也不一定会提高。根据人工智能模型，据说如果只选择必要的信息而不是传递所有记忆，它会表现得更好。阅读更多...

en.title: AI agents don't get smarter with more "memory", IBM Research tests on 8 models
en.summary: An IBM Research experiment showed that even if you give an AI agent a large amount of past experience as "memory", its performance will not necessarily improve. Depending on the AI ​​model, it is said that it will perform better if it selects only the necessary information rather than passing all of its memories. read more...

en.title: DeepSeek V4 Flash has high benchmark scores but is said to struggle with actual tasks, problems with orchestration
en.summary: Chinese AI company DeepSeek is developing high-performance AI models "DeepSeek-V4 Flash" and "DeepSeek-V4 Pro".
